sentences.en: On sunny days you can hear the crackling of the seed pods opening.

sentences.en: The woods of algarrobo are used for pasture, cattle and horses enjoying the pendulous yellow pods.
sentences.vi: Gỗ của algarrobo được sử dụng làm đồng cỏ, gia súc và ngựa thưởng thức những quả màu vàng lắc lư.

sentences.en: When ground cardamom is called for split the pods and grind the seeds, discarding the green pods.

sentences.en: Making espresso coffee at home has never been easier with the launch of Lyons espresso pods.
sentences.vi: Pha cà phê espresso tại nhà chưa bao giờ dễ dàng hơn thế với sự ra mắt của Lyons espresso pods.

sentences.en: The ripe seed pods burst open with a loud pop, throwing the seeds several feet.

sentences.en: I suspected they were some sort of alien pods waiting for a chance to take over our bodies and turn us into mindless zombies.
